result: No candidate. Every invariant derived for the subsystem held on every path I could read or run; the checks are listed in checked_no_candidate so that later hunters do not repeat them.
invariants_derived: I1 leaf sequence (mcycle level): leaf j of input slot i is the canonical hash after (j+1)*2^p mcycles counted from the state that receives input i; once the input reaches a fixed point (halt, manual yield, mcycle >= imcyclemax) every later leaf of the slot repeats that hash, the recorded revert root hash when the yield is rx-rejected; slots after the last input, and slots after a stop that takes no later input, repeat the final hash; the last leaf of the tree is the epoch's final state.

I2 leaf sequence (uarch level): each mcycle of the period owns 2^20 leaves: the hashes after uarch cycles 1..k-1, the halted hash from leaf k-1 to leaf 2^20-2, the hash after the reset at leaf 2^20-1 (the revert root hash on the rejecting mcycle); after a fixed point every remaining mcycle repeats the no-op mcycle of the canonical state (the reverted machine after a rejection); the last leaf of a uarch claim equals the mcycle-level leaf of that period (A1).

I3 the root is a function of I1/I2 alone: it does not depend on the bundle size, on how calls split mcycle_end, on automatic yields, on the partial bundle passed between calls, on forked versus stored players, or on store/reload of the forest between inputs.
I4 final_bundle_sibling_hashes always prove the rightmost leaf of the bundle the manual says they target, with the leaf the caller can read from the machine.
I5 collect_mcycle_bundle / collect_uarch_cycle_bundle return exactly the leaves the bundled collection committed to, for bundles before, across and after the fixed point.

I6 frontier forest: root, node hashes and sibling paths equal those of the naive full tree for any sequence of append / push_back / pad_back of raw hashes and nested full forests, after store, load and expand_leaf; an expansion never changes a root; a query below an opaque hash returns nil instead of a wrong value; a forest restored from a last-leaf proof answers the retained path and everything appended after it.

I7 Dave Commitment/Tree/Match: a leaf is accepted only with exactly height siblings at the referee-derived position (requireState, requireFinalState), the agreed leaf d-1 lies in a subtree both commitments share, the two contested leaves differ, an inner commitment counts only if its last leaf is one of them, and the inner start cycle and initial hash come from the sealed parent match.
I8 the player's bundle opening is authenticated against the committed root (expand_leaf hash check) and maps a leaf position to the same (input, period, mcycle) the referee derives.

Reasoned, no candidate: uarch runs that reach the last bundle of an mcycle (halt pad count zero, execution_reached_final_bundle) for every bundle height, including a halt on the step that reaches cycle 2^20-1; zero-progress re-entry of the collectors (no duplicate sample: a console or automatic-yield break always follows at least one instruction); H and Y both set (unreachable: a halt or a manual yield stops the machine, and a delivery to H=1,Y=1 clears Y and leaves a halted machine that can never reject); two honest uarch claims with the same root for different periods sharing one self.trees entry (same root means same leaves; bundle collection for either period rebuilds the same bundle); R4-RGPROOF-1's equal-hash trees of different base height (not reachable from the player: its mcycle forest only stores trees based at the bundle height or below it inside a bundle-height value, and its uarch forest stores raw mcycle roots; an input slot is a whole aligned power of two, so each slot flushes into one fixed-point tree and its padding shares one entry); leaf versus inner-node confusion between a state hash and a commitment node (needs a 32-byte word hash to equal a 64-byte node hash; the referee fixes the height in any case).
not_covered: Dense uarch periods and whole epochs at the released Dave geometry (p=18, heights 54/38): player runs used p=10; only the code paths, not the released sizes, were exercised (cost belongs to R1-A7-1).

Linux guests: every dynamic check used the bare-metal emit-output template (short inputs of 34-69 mcycles and 5M-mcycle inputs with two automatic yields); interrupts, page walks and TLB-heavy uarch mcycles were not sampled here (earlier rounds did part of this).

Automatic yields or console-output breaks landing exactly on a sampling point that completes a bundle were only reasoned about (period 2^0 on a long input was not run); console output to_buffer was not run.

Uarch mcycles with close to 2^20 cycles cannot be produced by a pristine uarch; the execution_reached_final_bundle branch for bundle heights below 20 was only reasoned about (height 20 takes it on every mcycle and was run).

The imcyclemax fixed point reached by a guest that really runs 2^48 mcycles was not executed; only the saturated variant (imcyclemax = 2^64-1) was, with a template whose mcycle register was set through write_reg rather than through a configuration.

Nothing was run on the chain or the EVM harness in this angle: Dave's Commitment/Tree/Match were read against the player's proofs, relying on the PRT demo for the end-to-end path; DaveConsensus, the provider and the sling/Dave node commitment builders were not examined.
